## 1 · Current upstream parity / 当前上游基线
This graph follows LBH-123-AI workflow commit `64fc9d4`: corrected LightX2V FL2V Turbo `comfyui_alpha8` conversion at loader strength 1.0, I2V shift `12/3`, Comfy `simple` 8-step schedule split after four low-resolution calls, then the published raw 3-call refine sigmas `0.9035, 0.6316, 0.3158, 0`. Do not remap those values through a guessed shift-6 reference.
nodes.title: 1 · Current upstream parity / 当前上游基线

widgets_values:
## 2 · Automatic size synchronization / 尺寸自动同步
Change only Learned Latent Upscale `scale_by`. Its `width` and `height` outputs are already connected to HIGH Conditioning. Do not create a second manual width/height. Default `2.0x` turns the LOW `736x416` latent into `1472x832`.
nodes.title: 2 · Change only one size / 只改一个倍率

widgets_values:
## 3 · Required pass handoff + audio clock / 二采接线与音频时钟
Pass 1 must feed `denoised_output` into the learned upscaler. HIGH Conditioning is rebuilt after the upscaler reports its actual aligned size, then Reconcile verifies the contract. Keep Reconcile at `second_pass_audio_source=legacy_policy` for native author parity: pass 2 must complete both video and audio. The custom dual-clock sampler rebases the partial pass-2 audio start from video sigma onto its own audio sigma before the first model call. Do not insert Two-Pass Audio Audit here; that node is only for an intentional zero-mask source lock. AV Decode receives the pass-2 sampler output directly.
nodes.title: 3 · Required pass handoff / 二采接线

widgets_values:
## 4 · Optional detail and memory / 可选细节与显存
Keep Tail/Bias/STG/Restart OFF for upstream parity. They alter the HIGH refine path and require a separate A/B review. Learned latent upscale saves first-pass compute, not the high-resolution peak VRAM. `offload_after` releases only the learned resizer.
nodes.title: 4 · Optional detail and memory / 可选细节与显存

widgets_values:
## 5 · Known-good starting values / 建议参数
LOW `736x416x124`; scale mode `scale_by`; scale `2.0`; output `1472x832`; video/audio shift `12/3`; base/coarse/refine `8/4/3`; Euler; all optional detail toggles OFF. Use only the `_comfyui_alpha8` LightX2V conversion; the superseded plain `_comfyui` file applies 16x excessive LoRA strength and destroys frames.

integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1] Live-action Chinese period comedy with the visual atmosphere of a stylized historical court film: warm lantern light, dark wood architecture, restrained classical composition, textured fabrics, subtle film grain, and crisp rhythmic editing. The setting is an ancient audience hall repurposed as a strange imperial selection chamber. Three attractive adult Chinese women in their twenties wait in a line beside carved wooden screens. They wear elegant low-necked, camisole-inspired ancient Chinese dresses with layered silk outer robes, tasteful but visually striking, combining period costume with a playful anachronistic concept. Each woman holds a wooden placard clearly facing the camera: "LTX", "Seedance 2.0", and "全能生视频". At the far end, a stern Chinese official sits behind a long wooden table like a judge. The camera tracks along the three women in medium-close framing, then whips toward the official. In a deep impatient male voice (S1), he says: <d>[Chinese] 第一个，上前。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:02.200, the LTX woman (S2) steps forward, bows slightly, and smiles with practiced confidence. A close frontal shot keeps her wooden "LTX" placard visible. The official looks her up and down, taps the table with one finger, and asks (S1): <d>[Chinese] 有何本事？</d> She hesitates, then answers softly (S2): <d>[Chinese] 小女子……什么都会一点。</d> The official immediately waves his sleeve dismissively and says (S1): <d>[Chinese] 一点？退下。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:05.100, the Seedance 2.0 woman (S3) strides forward without waiting to be called, chin raised and visibly smug. The camera arcs quickly around her into a close-up as her silk outer layer sways dramatically. She says in an overly confident, slightly provocative female voice (S3): <d>[Chinese] 如今外面，谁不知道我的名号？</d> The official slowly turns toward her, expression growing increasingly irritated. He replies coldly (S1): <d>[Chinese] 本官偏偏最烦你这号。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the Seedance 2.0 woman starts protesting and takes half a step forward, saying (S3): <d>[Chinese] 你敢——</d> The official suddenly stands, steps around the table, and delivers one exaggerated comedic kick that sends her flying sideways through an open curtain in a clearly theatrical, non-graphic period-comedy manner. Her wooden "Seedance 2.0" placard flips through the air and lands loudly on the stone floor. Two attendants in the background freeze and exchange awkward looks.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.300, the "全能生视频" woman (S4) walks forward calmly. Unlike the others, she does not pose or brag. She holds her "全能生视频" wooden placard steadily at chest level. The camera pushes slowly into a medium-close shot, emphasizing her composed eyes and restrained confidence. The official returns to his seat, watches her carefully, and asks (S1): <d>[Chinese] 你又会什么？</d> She gives a faint smile and answers in a calm, assured female voice (S4): <d>[Chinese] 大人要什么，我便做什么。</d>

[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of the official. He pauses, then suddenly slaps the table once with satisfaction and says decisively (S1): <d>[Chinese] 留下！</d> The shot cuts back to the "全能生视频" woman calmly lowering her eyes with a small victorious smile. In the distant background beyond the curtain, the Seedance 2.0 woman briefly pokes her head back in angrily before an attendant immediately pulls the curtain shut. Hold on the absurdly serious imperial selection atmosphere through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Indoor ancient hall ambience with faint wind outside, silk fabric movement, wooden footsteps, sleeve swishes, table taps, and quiet room reverberation. The Seedance 2.0 elimination includes a stylized comedic kick impact, the wooden placard clattering across stone, and a brief curtain flutter. Dialogue remains crisp and dominant.

non_diegetic_music:
Playful Chinese period-comedy score built from pipa, muted drums, wooden clappers, and short flute phrases. The rhythm becomes quicker when Seedance 2.0 enters, pauses for half a beat before the kick, then lands with a sharp drum-and-clapper accent. When "全能生视频" appears, the music shifts into a calmer, confident pipa motif and finishes with one decisive gong-like accent after "留下！".
